name: RAS p21 protein activator 1

function.text: RASA1 encodes ras GTPase-activating protein 1. Annotated molecular activities include GTPase activity and GTPase activator activity. It participates in signal transduction and intracellular signal transduction.

germline.text: Retained constitutional disease associations include capillary malformation-arteriovenous malformation 1 (autosomal dominant). Pathogenicity and inheritance depend on the specific allele and disorder.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma; Lung Squamous Cell Carcinoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from Ambry Genetics. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
